info.title: FUJIFILM GFX100S Emulator HTTP Control API
info.description:
Loopback (`127.0.0.1`) HTTP Control API for inspecting and automating a live FUJIFILM GFX100S emulator session.

- **Security**: Bound exclusively to loopback (`127.0.0.1`). Cross-origin browser requests are denied (`400`); JSON write endpoints require `Content-Type: application/json` and bodies are capped at 64 KiB.
- **Error Contract**: `400` invalid input / cross-origin / bad Content-Type, `404` unavailable component or unknown route, `409` optimistic-concurrency revision conflict (`PATCH /api/v1/components/{id}`), `503` runtime busy / executor rejected / upload unavailable, `500` internal error.
- **Live Self-Documentation**: Served directly at `GET /api/docs` (offline interactive HTML explorer) and `GET /api/openapi.json` (OpenAPI 3.1.0 schema).

get.description: Queries the bundled GFX100S 2.13 MMIO/memory address dictionary using up to 16 distinct query parameters.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Hex or decimal MMIO/memory address to look up (e.g. `0xfff40000`).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional free-text search term across device/region names and notes.

400.description: Duplicate, malformed, or excessive (>16) query parameters.

get.summary: Get live emulator and component state snapshot
get.description: Returns the complete component roster (id, revision, config, state) merged with the live `machine` execution telemetry map.

200.description: Current component snapshot and machine telemetry.

post.summary: Trigger a memory and state dump
post.description: Captures an emulator state/memory dump archive via the runtime dump handler. Body must be empty or `{}`.

400.description: Non-empty JSON object or missing `application/json` Content-Type.

example.error: dump body must be empty or {}

patch.summary: Patch live settings of a hardware component
patch.description: Applies a live settings patch to component `{id}` with optimistic concurrency control using its current `revision` from `GET /api/v1/state`.

changes.description: Key-value map of live component settings to update.

200.description: Updated component descriptor with incremented revision.

400.description: Malformed payload, invalid setting key/value, or wrong Content-Type.

post.summary: Start asynchronous performance profiler
post.description: Starts sampling CPU/PC hot spots and subsystem timings. `intervalMs` may be provided as a query parameter or JSON body field (body overrides query).

parameters.name: intervalMs
parameters.description: Sampling interval in milliseconds (defaults to profiler default).

400.description: Invalid `intervalMs` or non-JSON body.

404.description: Profiler not attached to this session.

post.summary: Stop profiler and fetch report
post.description: Stops active profiling and returns the collected report as JSON, or as `text/plain` when `?format=text|txt` or `Accept: text/plain` is sent.

200.description: Profiler stopped with summary report (JSON or plain text).

404.description: Profiler not attached to this session.

get.description: Returns the current or last completed profiler report without stopping a running session. Supports `text/plain` via `?format=text|txt` or `Accept: text/plain`.

404.description: Profiler not attached to this session.

post.summary: Send a rear-LCD touch event
post.description: Injects a single capacitive touch down/move/up event onto the rear LCD (`rear-touch-ic` preferred, falling back to `i2c-bus`). Payload must contain exact keys `x`, `y`, `pressed`.

x.description: Horizontal touch coordinate (`0..65535`; rear LCD native range `0..1023`).

y.description: Vertical touch coordinate (`0..65535`; rear LCD native range `0..767`).

pressed.description: `true` for finger down/move, `false` for finger release.

400.description: Missing/extra keys or out-of-range coordinates.

example.error: touch payload requires exact keys: x, y, pressed

post.summary: Send a multi-step rear-LCD touch swipe/flick
post.description: Executes a calibrated multi-step capacitive swipe gesture. Provide either a cardinal `direction` (`up`/`down`/`left`/`right`) OR explicit `x1`/`y1`/`x2`/`y2` endpoints (never both). Default `4` steps x `20 ms` satisfies both LiveView T-Fn flicks (<260 ms) and Playback slide-commit (>341 px).

x1.description: Start X coordinate (`0..65535`). Required when `direction` is omitted.

y1.description: Start Y coordinate (`0..65535`). Required when `direction` is omitted.

x2.description: End X coordinate (`0..65535`). Required when `direction` is omitted.

y2.description: End Y coordinate (`0..65535`). Required when `direction` is omitted.

steps.description: Number of intermediate move steps (`1..8`, default `4`).

400.description: Invalid direction, mixed direction+coordinates, or out-of-range steps/stepMs.

example.error: touch swipe payload cannot mix direction with x1/y1/x2/y2

get.summary: Get EVF eye proximity sensor state
get.description: Inspects the TMD2772 (or `i2c-bus` fallback) eye proximity state along with active viewfinder detection (`LCD`, `EVF`, `BOTH`, or `WAITING`) and display frame sequences.

200.description: Current eye sensor and viewfinder routing state.

post.summary: Set EVF eye proximity sensor
post.description: Sets whether an eye is detected near the EVF (`near: true` switches automatic viewfinder routing to EVF; `false` returns to rear LCD).

near.description: `true` for eye close to EVF, `false` for eye away.

400.description: Payload missing exact `near` boolean key.

example.error: eye-sensor payload requires exact key: near

get.summary: Inspect ADC buttons, dials, and channel samples
get.description: Returns live `soc-adc` control states (`qButton`, `aelButton`, `modeDial`, `fn1Button`..`fn3Button`, `lightButton`, rear command dial, and channel overrides) plus sampled ADC register counts.

200.description: Current `soc-adc` control values and sample counters.

post.summary: Update ADC buttons, dials, or raw channel overrides
post.description: Updates a non-empty subset of `soc-adc` inputs, including momentary buttons, mode dial, relative `rearDialStep` detent increments, or raw 12-bit channel overrides (`-1` clears override).

fn1Button.description: Press/release the Fn1 / Exposure Comp (`+/-`) button.

lightButton.description: Press/release the top LCD backlight button.

rearDialPosition.description: Explicit rear dial quadrature phase (`-1..3`, `-1` uses detents).

rearDialDetents.description: Absolute rear command dial detent counter (`-10000..10000`).

rearDialStep.description: Relative rear command dial detent delta (`-1000..1000`).

400.description: Empty payload, unknown key, wrong type, or out-of-range integer.

example.error: adc payload requires non-empty subset of [...]

get.summary: Get S/C/M focus mode lever state
get.description: Inspects the `soc-gpio` focus mode selector (`focusMode` configuration and resolved `effectiveFocusMode`).

post.summary: Set S/C/M focus mode lever
post.description: Sets the physical S/C/M focus mode lever via exact key `focusMode` or `mode`. Accepts `AF-S` (`AFS`/`S`), `AF-C` (`AFC`/`C`), `MF` (`M`), or `default`.

400.description: Invalid key or unsupported focus mode value.

example.error: focus-mode payload requires exact key: focusMode (or mode)

get.summary: Get combined STILL/MOVIE, mode dial, and focus mode state
get.description: Reads the `buttons` STILL/MOVIE lever (`movieMode`), `soc-adc` `modeDial`, and `soc-gpio` `effectiveFocusMode` in a single request.

post.summary: Update STILL/MOVIE switch, mode dial, and/or focus mode
post.description: Updates one or more of `mode` (`STILL`/`MOVIE`/`PHOTO`/`VIDEO`), `movieMode` (boolean), `modeDial`, and `focusMode`.

200.description: Updated shooting mode summary with applied `changes`.

400.description: Empty payload or invalid field value.

example.error: mode must be STILL or MOVIE

post.summary: Press or release the VIEW MODE button
post.description: Asserts or releases the hardware VIEW MODE GPIO button (`pressed: true` / `false`) to cycle LCD/EVF viewfinder modes.

pressed.description: `true` to press VIEW MODE, `false` to release.

400.description: Payload missing exact `pressed` boolean key.

example.error: view-mode payload requires exact key: pressed

post.summary: Upload current diagnostic session log
post.description: Triggers a manual upload of the current emulator diagnostic log when telemetry is explicitly enabled. Optional `notes` may be passed in the query string or JSON body.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Optional operator notes attached to the uploaded diagnostic bundle.

notes.description: Optional operator notes (overrides query parameter if provided).

400.description: Non-string `notes` or invalid JSON body.

503.description: Upload attempted but failed or telemetry disabled (`uploaded == false`).

get.summary: Get audio output and input mixer state
get.description: Returns live WM8962 + host audio engine state, volume, mute, backend, buffer size, headphone/mic jack state, and input capture settings.

post.summary: Update audio output, input, and jack settings
post.description: Applies a non-empty subset of live host audio mixer and jack-detection settings.

enabled.description: Enable or disable host audio playback.

bufferMs.description: Audio ring buffer latency target in milliseconds.

extMicPlugged.description: Simulate 3.5 mm external microphone jack insertion.

400.description: Empty body or unknown audio setting key.

example.error: audio update accepts non-empty subset of [...]

get.summary: List host audio output and input devices
get.description: Enumerates host playback and capture devices available to the emulator audio bridge.

get.summary: Get BCM43438 Wi-Fi / BLE wireless state
get.description: Returns the current BCM43438 wireless combo state (firmware download progress, BLE peer connection, Wi-Fi STA/AP state, and PTP-IP bridge status).

post.summary: Update BCM43438 virtual wireless peer state
post.description: Controls virtual mobile BLE/Wi-Fi peer attachment, advertised camera device name, or host PTP-IP bridge enablement.

blePeerConnected.description: Connect or disconnect the virtual BLE mobile peer.

wifiPeerConnected.description: Connect or disconnect the virtual Wi-Fi peer.

ptpIpBridgeEnabled.description: Enable or disable the host PTP-IP socket bridge.

400.description: No recognized wireless keys provided.

example.error: wireless update requires non-empty subset of [...]

get.summary: Get mounted lens optical and electronic state
get.description: Inspects the currently mounted lens template, focal length, aperture/iris sync, focus distance, OIS/optics flags, and mount contact protocol.

post.summary: Update mounted lens profile or optical parameters
post.description: Swaps the mounted lens template/adapter or adjusts live optical controls such as focal length, aperture ring mode (`A`/`C`/`MANUAL`), aperture, focus distance, OIS, and optics simulation.

adapterId.description: Mount adapter ID for adapted lenses (e.g. `fringer-ef-gfx`, `m42-gfx`).

realFirmwareFile.description: Path to real lens firmware file when using `REAL_FIRMWARE` mode.

subjectDistanceM.description: Optical scene subject distance in meters.

opticsEnabled.description: Enable/disable physically based lens optics pipeline.

400.description: Unknown lens key, null value, or invalid `apertureRingMode`.

example.error: apertureRingMode must be one of [A, C, MANUAL], got 'X'

get.description: Inspects the `optical-filter` component configuration and computed state across the ordered multi-slot rack (`slots`) as well as UV, ND, Bokeh Mask, Star, Black Mist, and Graduated ND stages.

post.summary: Configure optical filter stack
post.description: Configures the `optical-filter` stack using `clear`/`off`, an ordered `slots` array (up to 4 stacked filters), flat settings (`ndPreset`, `ndStops`, `uvPreset`, `bokehMask`, `star*`, `mist*`, `gnd*`), or nested shorthand objects (`uv`, `nd`, `bokeh`, `star`, `mist`, `gnd`).

clear.description: Reset all filter slots and stages to OFF.

slots.description: Ordered multi-slot rack array (max 4 filter objects with `type`) or encoded string.

mistEnabled.description: Enable black mist / diffusion glow filter.

uv.description: Nested UV shorthand object (`preset`, `transmittance`, `veilingGlare`, `ghostIntensity`, `softness`, `tintR/G/B`) or preset string.

400.description: No valid filter setting or unknown preset/shape.

example.error: filters update requires at least one valid filter setting

get.summary: Get ND filter transmittance and stop metrics
get.description: Returns dedicated neutral-density (ND) filter telemetry including stops, effective stops, filter factor, optical density, transmittance percentage, and human-readable summary.

post.summary: Configure ND filter stops or preset
post.description: Shorthand endpoint for setting the neutral-density filter by preset (`preset`/`ndPreset`), explicit EV stops (`stops`/`ndStops` in `0.0..10.0`), `enabled`, or `off: true`.

off.description: Set to `true` to clear ND filter to `OFF` (0 stops).

enabled.description: Enable or bypass optical filter processing.

400.description: Missing parameters, unknown preset, or out-of-range stops.

example.error: nd update requires preset, stops, off, or enabled

get.summary: Get active UI language and supported locales
get.description: Returns the current desktop studio UI locale and list of supported language codes.

post.summary: Switch desktop UI language live
post.description: Hot-switches the emulator desktop UI language without restarting. Provide exact key `language` or `lang`.

language.description: Target locale code (`en`, `zh_CN`, `ja_JP`, `de_DE`, `fr_FR`, `es_ES`). Provide either `language` or `lang`.

400.description: Missing exact key or unsupported locale.

example.error: lang payload requires exact key: language (or lang)

get.summary: Get active camera body and UI studio theme
get.description: Returns the currently active camera body theme (`body`) and desktop studio UI theme (`ui`), plus available presets.

post.summary: Switch camera body and/or studio UI theme
post.description: Hot-switches the camera body finish (`body`) and/or desktop studio UI theme (`ui`). Accepts a non-empty subset of `body` and `ui` with non-blank string values.

400.description: Empty body, unknown key, or blank theme string.

example.error: theme update requires non-empty subset of [body, ui]

post.summary: Hot-reload external camera body and UI themes
post.description: Rescans `./themes/body/` and `./themes/ui/` packs from disk, re-resolves the active camera body and UI themes, and notifies all live studio windows without restarting.

400.description: Non-empty request body.

example.error: theme reload body must be empty or {}

get.summary: Get unified 64 MiB QSPI NOR Flash status
get.description: Returns the active 64 MiB QSPI NOR Flash image path, boot path (`flash-direct` or `bootrom-nor`), BootROM presence, SHA-256 digest, writability, and committed erase/program counters.

post.summary: Flash .DAT firmware, export/import raw NOR image, or restore factory Flash
post.description: Performs a live host flasher action against the unified 64 MiB QSPI NOR Flash image (`write-dat`, `export`, `import`, or `restore-factory`). Mutating actions automatically reload the component host and cold-reboot the camera.

path.description: Source or destination file path (required for `write-dat`, `export`, and `import`; resolved relative to emulator home if not absolute).

preserveCalibration.description: For `write-dat` only: preserve calibration and user settings `[0x02FE0000..0x04000000)` (default `true`).

400.description: Invalid action, missing path, or unknown field.

example.error: unsupported flash action 'bad' (expected: write-dat, export, import, restore-factory)

get.description: Serves the deterministically generated OpenAPI 3.1.0 JSON schema describing every route on this ControlServer, ready for Swagger UI, Postman, Apifox, Bruno, Insomnia, or Redoc.
